title: Rapid battery drain and background power consumption
symptoms: Device heats up even on static menu screens
causes: Rendering static UI/menus at uncapped 60/120 FPS
Keeping location/GPS or continuous network polling active in background

solution.action: Lower target FPS to 30 on static menu and inventory screens.
Pause network polling loops and audio when app transitions to background.

prevention: Audit energy impact with Android Battery Historian and Xcode Energy Gauge.
